channel.description: Latest articles from The Times of Israel (timesofisrael.com)

item.title: Syrian government, Kurds agree on integration deal; US hails ‘historic milestone’
item.description: Deal will see Syrian Democratic Forces gradually merged into state's military after Syrian army captured swaths of Kurdish enclaves this month The post Syrian government, Kurds agree on integration deal; US hails ‘historic milestone’ appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US Justice Department releases millions of new Epstein documents
item.description: Three million pages of documents, 180,000 images, 2,000 videos included in latest release; faces of all women except Ghislaine Maxwell redacted The post US Justice Department releases millions of new Epstein documents appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Satellite images indicate Iran working to salvage nuclear materials from damaged sites
item.description: Experts say new roofs at Isfahan, Natanz likely part of effort 'to assess whether key assets, such as limited stocks of highly enriched uranium, survived the strikes' by Israel and US The post Satellite images indicate Iran working to salvage nuclear materials from damaged sites appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US okays over $6.5 billion in new military sales to Israel, including Apache gunships
item.description: Pentagon says package also includes $1.98 billion of light armored utility vehicles * Two Palestinians reportedly wounded by settler arson attack in southern West Bank The post US okays over $6.5 billion in new military sales to Israel, including Apache gunships appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: IDF launches series of airstrikes on Hezbollah targets in south Lebanon
item.description: Military says the strikes killed a Hezbollah operative, destroyed infrastructure and heavy machinery belonging to Lebanese terror group The post IDF launches series of airstrikes on Hezbollah targets in south Lebanon appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Two Palestinians said wounded by settler arson attack in West Bank
item.description: Resident of hamlet near Ramallah says locals earlier warned Israeli security forces of potential attack, but troops left before assailants arrived; no immediate comment from IDF The post Two Palestinians said wounded by settler arson attack in West Bank appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Anti-Zionist protesters disrupt Israel critic Ezra Klein with genocide accusations
item.description: Demonstrators claim the NYT journalist is a 'Nazi normalizer'; ahead of disruption, campus branch of Students for Justice in Palestine had denounced Klein as a 'Zionist pig' The post Anti-Zionist protesters disrupt Israel critic Ezra Klein with genocide accusations appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Top US attorney in Minnesota was once on board of Jewish group now protesting ICE
item.description: Daniel Rosen, whose office is involved in several controversial cases relating to Trump's immigration enforcement push, was confirmed in part for his leadership on Jewish issues The post Top US attorney in Minnesota was once on board of Jewish group now protesting ICE appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Moroccan language course revives lost Jewish culture while bridging Mideast divide
item.description: Yona Elfassi, one of the few remaining Jews in Morocco, runs course teaching Darija to Moroccan Diaspora Jews, inspiring Muslims in the country to reach out to learn Hebrew The post Moroccan language course revives lost Jewish culture while bridging Mideast divide appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Nazi-era teen girl’s diary charts unraveling of France — and her prominent Jewish family
item.description: Released in the UK on Jan. 22, 'Ninette's War' by journalist John Jay examines darkest chapter in French history through a Dreyfus scion's diary entries, family papers and interviews The post Nazi-era teen girl’s diary charts unraveling of France — and her prominent Jewish family appeared first on The Times of Israel.
